  #   c3 with words

    gamma: # c7

# c10
# c11
oauth:
  #   c12 with words
  auth-dir: &s13 "" #   c14 with words
  # c15
  settings:
    ' claude ':
      # c16
      #c17
      - 'name': &s18 'm1' # c19
        alias: "a1" # c20
        max-context-length: 272000
      - {name: "gemini-2.5-pro", alias: sol, max-context-length: 200000} #c21
    #c22
    gemini-cli: # c23
      - name: ' gemini-2.5-pro ' # c24
        alias: *s13
        # c25
        max-context-length: 200000 #c26
      # c27
      - {name: 'gpt-6-sol', 'alias': "", 'max-context-length': 272000} #   c28 with words
# c29
  providers: {antigravity: {connection-pool: {'enabled': false}}}
  request-scoped-errors:
    'gemini-cli':
      #c30
      # c31
      - {status: 400, 'action': stop, "match": [" gemini-1.5-* ", GPT-5.5-MINI]} # c32
      # c33
# c34
      - {status: 400, action: "continue", match: ['claude-2*']} #c35
    # c36

upstream: # c37
  # c38
  codex:
    #   c39 with words
    stream-bootstrap-buffering: false
    #c40
    'orphan-delegation-compatibility': false # c41
    'stream-bootstrap-timeout': '10s'
  # c42
  claude: #   c43 with words
    # c44
    header-defaults: {user-agent: example-agent/1.0, package-version: '1.0.0', runtime-version: "v22.0.0", arch: "x64", timeout: '600', stabilize-device-profile: true} # c45
  xai:
    inject-x-search: true
observability:
  # c46
  'pprof':
    enable: true # c47
  logs: {error-logs-max-files: 10, request-log: false, logs-max-total-size-mb: -1} # c48
models:
  # c49
  catalog: https://catalog.example/models.json
#c50
routing: #c51
  cooldown:
    transient-error-cooldown-seconds: -1
#   c52 with words
client: #c53
  #   c54 with words
  #   c55 with words
  codex: {"optimize-multi-agent-v2": false, enable-apply-patch: true}
